name: macos-log
description: Read the Mac's unified log from inside the jail (yolo-log). Every request is narrowed to the macos-user sandbox account's processes unless this loophole's own `full` setting says otherwise.

full.description: pass yolo-log's arguments to `log` unchanged, reading every entry on the Mac (the host user must be allowed to read the log, which an admin is); false keeps `show` and `stream` only and sends only entries logged by the macos-user sandbox account's processes
